title: Figma library reorganization: normalize auto-layout, merge redundant variants, and standardize naming
text:
Figma library reorganization: normalize auto-layout, merge redundant variants, and standardize naming

description:
Goal: Reduce maintenance overhead and surface confusion by reorganizing the Figma component library. Focus areas: 1) normalize auto-layout properties (spacing, padding, axis alignment) across button, table row, and card components, 2) identify and merge redundant variants (icon-only vs icon-left), 3) unify naming conventions for component and token names (semantic tokens preferred), and 4) establish a publishing cadence and checklist to avoid breaking downstream usage.

Background: Over the last year multiple contributors created variant forks and inconsistent auto-layout rules causing duplicated instances in product files, misaligned spacing, and confusions when exporting tokens to code. This ticket consolidates decisions and ships a curated library update with migration notes.

acceptance_criteria:
1) All primary components (Button, IconButton, TableRow, DataTableHeader, Card, Badge) use a documented auto-layout baseline; 2) Redundant variants reduced by at least 60% and merged into purposeful variant groups with descriptive variant names; 3) Token naming follows semantic pattern (e.g., button-bg-primary -> color-brand-500) and a token map for engineers is published; 4) Figma library published as a new major (v3) with release notes and migration guide; 5) No unresolved instances flagged by the downstream teams in the first week after publish.

steps:
- Audit existing library: collect list of components and variants, note inconsistent auto-layout properties. - Create a migration plan and mapping table for variant merges and token renames. - Prototype normalized auto-layout rules in a sandbox file and validate across common product screens. - Run a sweep to replace deprecated variants with new master components. - Update component documentation and token map in Confluence/Drive. - Publish library as v3 and communicate migration steps in #design-system and release email. - Monitor feedback and ship quick fixes for any regressions.

comments:
2025-11-06 Avery Cho: Kickoff audit complete. Found 74 components with duplicated variants; Button group has 12 variants across three masters.
2025-11-10 Riley Morgan: Prototype for auto-layout baseline uploaded to sandbox file. Button and Card look good at 8/16 px spacing. Need engineering input on token rename mapping.
2025-11-12 Samir Patel (Eng): ENG-4123 queued to update token export pipeline to accept new semantic names. Estimated 3 days.
2025-11-15 Design review: Decided to keep icon-only as a modifier instead of separate master. Variant names will use kebab case with semantic prefixes.
2025-11-18 Riley Morgan: Began sweep to replace deprecated instances in product files. Encountered one edge-case in billing UI where TableRow relies on custom padding — logged as follow-up.
2025-11-20 Avery Cho: Draft release notes posted; plan to publish v3 on 2025-11-25 pending final QA.

decisions:
Adopt semantic token prefix 'color-' and 'spacing-' for tokens
Icon-only will be a variant property on Button instead of separate master
Auto-layout baseline: axis=horizontal for rows, padding uniform 8/12/16 scale

risks:
Large library publish may break instances if consumers use detached copies
Token renames require coordinated deploy with ENG token export

next_steps:
Finish QA sweep (Riley). Finalize token map and handoff to engineering (Samir). Schedule publish announcement and office hours for migration questions.
